install:
set -euo pipefail
touch "$HOME/.bashrc"
sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true
FLUTTER_ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/flutter"
if [ ! -x "$FLUTTER_ROOT/bin/flutter" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share"
  ARCHIVE_URL=$(curl -fsSL https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/releases_linux.json | python3 -c "import sys, json; d = json.load(sys.stdin); h = d['current_release']['stable']; r = next(x for x in d['releases'] if x['hash'] == h); print(d['base_url'] + '/' + r['archive'])")
  TMP_TAR=$(mktemp /tmp/flutter_sdk.XXXXXX.tar.xz)
  curl -fsSL "$ARCHIVE_URL" -o "$TMP_TAR"
  rm -rf "$FLUTTER_ROOT"
  tar -xf "$TMP_TAR" -C "$HOME/.local/share"
  rm -f "$TMP_TAR"
fi
VENV_DIR="$HOME/.local/venv"
if [ ! -x "$VENV_DIR/bin/python" ]; then
  if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    uv venv "$VENV_DIR"
  else
    python3 -m venv "$VENV_DIR"
  fi
fi
if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
  if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    uv pip install --python "$VENV_DIR/bin/python" -r requirements.txt
  else
    "$VENV_DIR/bin/pip" install --no-input -r requirements.txt
  fi
fi
PATH_LINE='export PATH="$HOME/.local/venv/bin:$HOME/.local/share/flutter/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH"'
grep -qxF "$PATH_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$PATH_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/venv/bin:$HOME/.local/share/flutter/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH"
if ! git config --global --get-all safe.directory 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF "$FLUTTER_ROOT"; then
  git config --global --add safe.directory "$FLUTTER_ROOT" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
dart --disable-analytics >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
flutter config --no-analytics --no-cli-animations >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
flutter pub get
